title: Luckman: book's alien drawing matches a British Museum image

tellings.quote: And I've sent you the photo. I've sent you the photo out of the British Museum. It's the It's exactly the being that it was drawn by.

plain: A drawing of an alien in the 1970s book UFOs: Past, Present and Future, tied to the filmmakers Bob Emenegger and Allan Sandler, is said to match an ancient image held in the British Museum in London. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels this, passing on what a UFO writer named Michael Luckman told him, and says he has sent Michels the British Museum photo: 'It's exactly the being.' If true, it would suggest the same kind of being was pictured long ago.
